adn.resume_en: 26% show 3D relief/bevel (mean relief 4.1/10), 56% carry contour/rim glow (mean glow 4.9/10), 68% sit on a dark background and 62% on a gradient/atmospheric one, 12% of outlined marks use a thick (usually white) contour, 35% add particles/sparkles. Mean saturation 7.1/10, mean brightness 3.7/10, mean complexity 5.3/10. Dominant materials: plastic 22%, neon 19%, metal 9%, fabric 8%. Dominant palette: #FFFFFF, #FF0000, #1A1A1A, #111111, #FF00FF.

composition: Use a 16:9 aspect ratio with a symmetrical or balanced 3-layer depth structure: foreground (floating elements/characters), midground (central text/logo), and background.
Position 1 to 3 3D characters or a central vector emblem as the focal point, flanked symmetrically by secondary elements (lightning bolts, palm trees, or pillars).
Layer large-scale typography behind characters or central logos, occupying 60-80% of the horizontal canvas width.
Maintain a clear horizontal center line for primary text, with optional smaller subtext or social handles aligned in the bottom 15% of the frame.
typographie: Use ultra-bold, uppercase, italicized sans-serif or 3D block letters with metallic, gradient (white-to-color), or brushed textures.
Apply a thick dark outline (when contour is present) or a heavy drop shadow to separate text from complex backgrounds.
Integrate custom geometric cuts, stencil splits, or custom icons (stars, lightning bolts) directly into the main lettering (e.g., replacing the letter 'A').
lumiere: Implement high-contrast dual-source lighting: a strong primary key light (sunlight or studio white) paired with a vibrant neon rim light (pink, green, or blue).
Cast a strong radial backlighting glow behind the central logo or text to separate it from dark backgrounds.
Apply realistic ambient occlusion and drop shadows between overlapping 3D layers.
etalonnage: Nocturnal/Cyber: Deep purples (#120A18, #1A002C) and dark blues (#001C30, #051122) contrasted with neon magenta (#FF00FF) or cyan (#00A8E8).
Summer/Luxury: High-saturation blues (#1CA3EC, #1E88E5) paired with vibrant pinks (#FF6B8B, #FF4DA6) and warm gold/orange accents (#E5C158).
Aggressive/Esports: Dark charcoal/black (#121212, #1A1A1A) paired with high-intensity red (#FF0000, #C8000A) or toxic green (#76B900).
effets: Apply depth of field blur on extreme foreground elements (floating particles, snowflakes, leaves) and distant backgrounds.
Overlay subtle digital textures: scanlines, halftone dots, fine film grain, or light dust particles.
Incorporate volumetric light rays, smoke/fog overlays, and localized neon glows around light sources.
logo: Center a high-contrast geometric emblem or stylized anatomical icon directly behind or integrated with the main text.
Enclose the logo in a glowing neon geometric frame (triangle, shield, or circle) to anchor the composition.
interdits: Avoid flat, unlit 2D text layered over complex photographic backgrounds without drop shadows or outer glows.
Do not use low-contrast color schemes that make the central lettering illegible against the background.
Avoid asymmetrical clutter; do not place heavy character models on one side without a balancing element on the opposite margin.
personnages: Pose characters with a confident, relaxed, or intimidating attitude: hands holding cash, gesturing, or holding weapons in a low guard.
Dress characters in premium streetwear (hoodies, denim tube tops, knit vests, graphic tees) layered with heavy chrome/gold jewelry and designer sunglasses.
Render skin with a clean, semi-realistic 3D game engine finish, showing detailed tattoos and soft-painted textures.
Frame shots as vertical medium close-ups (waist-up) or dynamic full-body poses next to luxury assets like sports cars or music studio desks.
